name: Call Chip
description: Compact status chip for a tool call showing an icon, name, argument and live timer, with a progress fill, icon swap and shake on failure. Fits AI agent and developer tool interfaces.
contents: Inline pill with tool icon, name, argument text and elapsed timer
Progress fill layer behind the content
Icon slot that swaps between tool, check and retry glyphs
Invisible retry button overlay shown on error when onRetry is given
Screen reader only live status text
behavior: Running: fill scales to 90% over expectedMs and the timer counts up each frame
Done: fill completes, turns green and wipes away, icon rolls to a green check
Error: fill freezes at its current progress with a red wash, chip shakes horizontally, icon rolls to a red retry glyph
Idle: fill resets to zero and timer shows a dash
Icon swap uses a blur and vertical slide transition
Retry button gives a pressed scale effect on pointer down
Reduced motion disables the shake and icon slide, and the timer updates every 100 ms
editableByProps: Tool icon, name and argument text
Status and expected duration of the progress fill
Size, corner radius, text, surface, progress, done and error colors
Fill and wash opacity, shake distance, timer visibility

needsCodeEdit.where: ICONS constant and the hugeicons import

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the status labels read by screen readers
Change how far the fill advances while running
Change the shake pattern or duration
needsCodeEdit.where: SHAKE constant and the animate call in the apply function

fixed: Requires the @hugeicons/react and @hugeicons/core-free-icons packages and Tailwind CSS with arbitrary value and group-data variants
Marked 'use client' and relies on browser APIs (Web Animations, DOMMatrix, matchMedia)
Status changes are driven only by the status prop, the chip does not run or finish tasks itself
Fill stops at 90% while running until status becomes done
Retry button only appears when status is error and onRetry is provided
Timer text is written directly to the DOM, and shows a dash when idle
Sizes of font, padding and gap derive from size
Timer column has a minimum width of 6ch
Default icon glyph set is limited to terminal, file, search and edit
Component has no frame and renders inline
